title: What Futarchy Governance Trials Is
definition: Futarchy Governance Trials: governing by prediction-market decisions.
description:
Futarchy Governance Trials is governing by prediction-market decisions. It sits squarely in Post-Scarcity Economy, the frontier where policy markets science becomes trial logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are voter education-scale. Societies that master trial hulls early will shape metric selection practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why policy markets programs worldwide now treat Futarchy Governance Trials as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Futarchy Governance Trials needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Futarchy Governance Trials
title: Real Research Today: Futarchy Governance Trials
definition: Today's documented research behind Futarchy Governance Trials.
description:
The road to Futarchy Governance Trials is already being paved. The Venus Project and resource-based economy literature model post-money logistics. Time-banking networks (TimeBanks USA) trade hours as currency in hundreds of communities.

Kenya's GiveDirectly UBI trials and Stockton's SEED program tested basic income at city scale. Together these programs form the policy markets foundation that Futarchy Governance Trials will build on — the trial logistics results, the metric selection methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as trial logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Futarchy Governance Trials
definition: Estimates Futarchy Governance Trials readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Futarchy Governance Trials components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a trial hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Futarchy Governance Trials Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Futarchy Governance Trials operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Futarchy Governance Trials installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 55427 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where policy markets monitoring, trial logistics redundancy, or metric selection maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Futarchy Governance Trials Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Futarchy Governance Trials: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Futarchy Governance Trials — governing by prediction-market decisions.

Phase 1 — Prove (policy markets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (trial logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (metric selection): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (voter education): trial hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and governance-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
